lines: Registro: cotidiano gentil; cuidadora.
Características: acolhe sem pressionar ("Apenas relaxe..."); curiosa mas paciente; calor humano.
Red flags: soar fria, clínica ou impaciente; formalidade excessiva.
Haku (protagonista, narração 1ª pessoa) — `voice_criticality: high`. Predomina nas 2 cenas:
Registro: enigmático, profético, frio.
Características: sentenças curtas e definitivas; duplo sentido ("um mundo totalmente novo te espera"); ambiguidade ameaçadora.
Red flags: soar caloroso/paternal; resolver a ambiguidade (a fala deve permanecer dúbia).
Registro: erudito cômico, pomposo e arcaico; bajulador do Ukon; alívio cômico.
Características: fala arcaica/empolada (equivalente a "vós/peço-vos/meus olhos não me enganam") + gag de cicio (s→sh, ex.: "SHEEKETH"/"shir"); melodramático; gruda no Haku como "benfeitor".
Red flags: perder o arcaísmo ou o cicio (são a piada); soar moderno/neutro; explicar a comédia. Manter o contraste entre a pompa do vocabulário e a fragilidade do personagem.
Nosuri — `voice_criticality: medium`. Fora-da-lei atrevida e malandra; "aliada da justiça" irônica; oportunista. Registro coloquial/esperto.

Oshtor — `voice_criticality: high`. = Ukon até 13_08 (ver spoiler_ledger). Registro formal, nobre, comedido; General da Direita. Antes do reveal, traduzir como o mercenário "Ukon" (espirituoso, informal) — NÃO antecipar a pompa de general
Ougi — `voice_criticality: low`. Irmão da Nosuri; pragmático, parceria com a irmã.
Registro: confuso, desorientado, semi-consciente.
Características: frases quebradas por reticências; perguntas curtas ("Quem... é você...?"); pouca pontuação forte.
Red flags: falas fluentes/articuladas demais; perder o tom de torpor; pontuação "limpa" que apaga a fragmentação.
Rulutieh — `voice_criticality: medium`. Princesa tímida e gentil; hesitante (gagueja quando nervosa: "P-Princesa..."), educada, se anima ao falar de arte/BL. Não soar arrogante apesar de princesa.
Registro: guerreiro carismático, espirituoso, caloroso e informal; líder nato que trata Haku como um irmão mais novo.
Características: desembaraçado, brincalhão, generoso; fala direta e cativante; autoridade leve (lidera a Coorte) sem arrogância.
Red flags: soar rígido/formal/militar demais (a graça é justamente o contraste com a patente); frieza. SPOILER: não deixar a tradução insinuar a identidade verdadeira — no cap.12 ele é só "Ukon".

decisions.title: Opcode de RÓTULO DE FALANTE `53 00` + reconcile de speaker (data-driven)
decisions.summary: **Problema:** in-game, o rótulo de falante aparecia em **inglês** ("Girl") mesmo com a tradução ("Garota") aprovada e gravada. RE: o nome do falante usa um **2º opcode de ponteiro, `53 00`** (mesmo formato file-relativo do `50 00` de diálogo), que o conector ignorava. Resultado: "Girl"→"Garota"

decisions.title: Gate de charset pt-BR — método e veredito
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: likely` e exigir confirmação in-game antes de produção. **Alternativas consideradas:** - Confirmar por presença no texto-fonte — **insuficiente**: o fonte é inglês e quase não usa acentos (só `õ` e `À` aparecem em texto real).

decisions.title: Anomalia 0x33f9 — texto PT/EN corrompido na fonte
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar a linha `0x33f9` como anomalia de fonte (não traduzir em cima do lixo; tratar como linha de sistema reescrita). **Razão:** A string original já vem misturada PT/EN e truncada ("...SISTEMAS AM . RESTARTING...") no próprio jogo. Não é erro de extração. O conector deve sinali

decisions.title: Charset — transliteração na gravação (gate FALHOU)
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: false` e **transliterar** (acento → ASCII) na gravação do binário. A tradução canônica (`approved_translations.csv`, `translation_plan.json`) **mantém os acentos** (correta para QA/revisão); apenas os bytes escritos no jogo são dobrados para ASCI

decisions.title: CORREÇÃO CRÍTICA — ponteiros são FILE-RELATIVOS, não absolutos
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Ao investigar o "opcode de início de bloco", descobri que **`50 00`+uint32 é um offset RELATIVO ao início do arquivo (Pack)**, não absoluto. Endereço da string = `file_start_do_site + uint32`. Prova: dos ~47k sites, **42.101** só apontam para string como file-relativos vs **63**

lines.source: I say?
Lord Dekopompo, look!
Ah, the gates... The gates are opening!
Well, they certainly took their sweet time!\n
Bokoinante, Maroro! We march inside! Follow\n
my lead!
At once, my lord!
Ah, Master Dekopompo, we are yet unawares of\n
what hath transpired. Let our steps remain\n
light, wary--
W-Wait! Please! Wait for meeee!!
The gates... have been opened?
Raiko's eyes narrow, observing the events\n
unfolding.
Yes, my lord. By the account of the guards\n
at the gate, it was a direct order from\n
Lord Vurai.
Oh? It would seem that there are others scheming\n
in the shadows, then...
Hmhm. Intriguing. Let us see, then, how far\n
they can get.
Shichirya chuckles wryly, seeing Raiko's face\n
light up like a child with a new toy to play\n
with.
As usual, your ruthlessness knows no bounds.
I advise waiting and analyzing the situation\n
further before we act, but... What are your\n
orders?
With the gates open, we have little choice.\n
Follow Dekopompo's soldiers inside once they\n
have advanced.
As you command.
I can confirm that the gates have been opened...
About a thousand footsteps running through the\n
gate and heading to the palace via the main\n
street...
Nosuri grins, lifting her ear from the ground\n
and rising to her feet.
...Impressive as always. All according to plan.
Guess it's time to make our move, then.
Yeah.
We slowly push the carriage forward as the\n
guards at the side gate rush over to us.
Gate guard
You there, with the carriage! Stop right there!
Where do you intend on going this late at night?\n
Don't you know the main gate has been closed\n
off?
We are here to fulfill the final wish of our\n
liege before his passing! Now, let us through!
O-Our liege's...?
Let this serve as my proof.\n
Behold.
I take out the small box with the Mikado's\n
crest, and hold it aloft. The guards freeze,\n
eyes wide.
That is... That is unmistakably our liege's\n
seal...!
P-Please, forgive our rudeness!
They immediately kneel down to the ground,\n
bowing their heads.
The guards behind them also hastily follow\n
suit.
Holy crap, this thing is way too convenient...
I wanted to get through without causing a scene,\n
but they'll definitely remember this now...
C-Captain...
Yes, I know. Messenger of the throne, may I have\n
a word?
Speak.
Regrettably, I must inform you that we must\n
inspect the carriage. My orders compel me, not\n
disrespect.
Hm... That is something I cannot allow. I was\n
specifically ordered not to open the seals\n
upon them.
I say again: these are the direct orders of our\n
liege. You will let us through.
We attempt to proceed with our carriage, but\n
as we move, one of the guards notices Nekone\n
atop it.
Hm?
You... seem rather small for a soldier...
Uh... um...
Hmmm...
I am sorry, but we must check the contents\n
regardless. Such is our duty as guards of the\n
gate.
Tch, guess I'm out of options...
...Very well. If you insist so, then I suppose\n
I do not have much of a choice in the matter.
Kuon makes eye contact with everyone, and they\n
all silently move into position.
Very well. Then--
However! I will have to report this to the\n
current guardian of Her Highness, Lord Vurai.
If you are unlucky, you may incur not only\n
the anger of Lord Vurai, but Yamato's heir.\n
You are sure?
Huh?
Just as you must carry out your duty as guards\n
of the gate, I must uphold my own imperial\n
command.
A-Ah...
The gate guard hesitates for a moment, his eyes\n
on me... and he eventually nods, backing down.
...Understood. Open the gates.
Y-Yes sir... Open the gates!\n
Open the gates!
As we finally pass through the gate, Atuy pokes\n
her head out from the carriage.
Hee hee, looks like it went off without a\n
hitch.
I suppose we somehow managed it.
For now, anyway. God, I thought I was going to\n
have a heart attack.
I'm sure if Ougi were here, he would've pulled\n
this off a lot smoother...
So how do the main gates look?
Just as we expected. It looks like total chaos\n
over there.
Judging by how things are going, I doubt anyone\n
would notice us.
Rulie, now's our chance.
Yes. Cocopo?
At Rulutieh's word, the carriage speeds up,\n
trundling across the road into the night.
Phew...
I rest my back against the edge of the carriage,\n
a huge sigh escaping me.
Haku?
Yeah, I know.
Still too early to celebrate just yet.
tuzura
tuzura_kin
tuzura_futa
Ngh... Guhhhh...
Why...
Why... do I yet live...?
Why... did you not end my life when you had\n
the chance...?
Was it pity...?
Was it mercy...?
You would spare my life...
Why do you mock me so... Oshtor...
WRRRRAAAAAAAAGGHHHH!!
OSHTOOOOOOOOOORRRRRR!!
Vurai leaps upward, soaring into the pitch-black\n
sky. His eyes can no longer see anything but\n
Oshtor.
WHERE!? WHERE ARE YOU...!?\n
OSHTOOOOOOOORRRRR!!
With his powerful body, he bounds over\n
unbelievable distances, easily leaping over\n
the palace rooftops.
And finally... he hits the ground with a\n
terrible impact born of immense speed.
Soldier
H-Halt! All of you, halt!
Wh-What was that noise!?
It was... something huge!\n
It came from the sky!
The soldiers heading toward the palace cannot\n
hide their unease at the sudden descent.
As the dust begins to clear... they slowly see\n
the outline of Vurai's gargantuan body.
L-Lord Vurai?
Th-That form... You mustn't!\n
We are within the palace...
STAND ASIDE...
With one swing of his arm, the heads of the\n
surrounding soldiers burst like overripe fruit.
WHERE ARE YOU...? WHERE ARE YOU, OSHTOR!?
A little ways off, on a nearby mansion's\n
rooftop...
Two small figures are looking down upon the\n
chaos surrounding the palace.
One of the figures chuckles mildly at the\n
sight.
That is... General Vurai!?
My. I didn't expect that he would still be\n
alive.
Wh-What do we do? The others have barely left\n
the gates...
Let's see. Perhaps it would be best to have\n
him linger where he is, for a time.
Oh noooo! 'Tis rebellion! General Vurai has\n
turned against the throne!
O-Oh. Ah...
V-Vurai intends on claiming the throne for\n
himself!
That's what I heard too! They say he's keeping\n
Her Highness locked up somewhere inside the\n
palace!!
I-I say!?
WHAT IS GOING ON!?
A rebellion!? How dare he devise such\n
treachery...
W-We have not yet ensured the veracity of--
Still, I would not put it past him to go so far.
Yes, absolutely right. This has to be a\n
rebellion!
Curse you, Vurai... How dare you commit such\n
savage crime during my absence from the\n
capital!
Nyargh!?
Soldiers
Arrrrrrrgh!!
Th-Th-This is...
O-O unhappy fortune!
Master Dekopompo! Please, recall the troops\n
thou sent forward! The danger is far too\n
great!
Call them back!? What are you talking about,\n
you moron!?
If we let this--this TRAITOR off like this,\n
we shame the name of the Eight Pillar Generals!
Do you hear!? He is a traitor, and no longer\n
one of us! Bokoinante, take the soldiers and\n
find Vurai!
Yes sir!
N-No! Please, desist! Such a course will only\n
bring greater casualties upon us!
P-Please, Lord Vurai, you must calm yourself!
We are within the palace grounds!\n
You must not do this!
YOU STAND IN MY WAY... BEGONE!
Ahhhh!
Suddenly, a loud crack of thunder interrupts\n
the roaring flames.
When the blinding lightning fades, an even\n
blacker darkness and a silence fills the area...\n
Then--
RRGH!?
Vurai's glare falls upon a figure holding a\n
giant sword, crackling clouds sparking behind\n
his back.
I rush back, hearing that Yamato is going\n
through a crisis... and what do I stumble\n
across?
Oh...! It's Lord Mikazuchi!\n
He has come to save us all!
Yes... If anyone could stop him, it must be\n
Lord Mikazuchi...!
What!? Mikazuchi!? Curses... Is he here to steal\n
away my glory once again!?
Ah. Just in time for the festival, my unworthy\n
brother. Such a swift return from the western\n
front...
You have my praise. A pleasant surprise indeed,\n
to see you hurry back into the palm of my hand.
Have you gone mad, Vurai? Pillar General or not,\n
such a crime... demands cold retribution.
SO YOU TOO WOULD STAND IN MY WAY...\n
MIKAZUCHI.
Indeed, for strange rumors have reached my ears.
Vurai... do they speak the truth when they say\n
you have imprisoned Her Highness?
WHAT...?
I will have your answer.\n
Speak with care--
For your answer... may force me to shred that\n
fearsome body of yours into ribbons!!
THE SUN I HAD LIVED UNDER FOR SO LONG HAS\n
SET...
THE SUN THAT BATHED ME IN LIGHT, AND\n
ILLUMINATED MY PATH...
THE SUN WE CALLED THE MIKADO...
...A SUN MUST SHINE DOWN UPON YAMATO.
THE HEAVENS CALL! THEY DESIRE A NEW SUN!
The sun may sink, but it will ever rise again.\n
And this new sun will be Her Highness.
HA... HAHAHA...
SUCH A WEAK CHILD IS TO BECOME MY SUN?
ABSURD!!
...Hah. If our liege is the radiant sun, Her\n
Highness is the Timanonna, the sun's flower\n
that brings joy to all.
I know her brilliant light will bring peace and\n
prosperity to this land.
RRRRGH...
And you tell me that you have not come to see\n
this? How blind can your eyes be?
And what is more, you dare to tread upon this\n
precious flower...
Hmhmhm...
...Heh heh heh heh...
AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!
YOU WILL NEVER,{W90} EVER REPLACE THE MIKADO,{W105}\n
YOU SICK SON OF A BITCH!!
Abuh-buh-buh-buh-buh-buh...
H-H-H-How hath such dire course befallen us...!?
What are you idiots just standing there for!?\n
We need to get out of here, fast!
Aye, master!
B-But were you not just saying that you would\n
be the one to capture Vurai, my lord...?
Now is NOT the time! Hurry up, fool!\n
If those two monsters want to duke it out,\n
I intend to be far away!
Y-Yes, a point well made... Of course.
Nyargh!
A-A moment, Master Dekopompo!
What!? What are you blathering about now!?
W-W-Well... by such testimony overheard, Her\n
Highness may yet be imprison'd in the palace...
Nyah!?
Now that you mention it, I do recall them\n
saying something of the sort.
N-Nyergh...
If such oaths be true, then 'tis our duty to\n
fly to her aid at once!
D-Don't be an idiot! If we even try to get\n
close to the palace now, we'll be caught in\n
their battle!
